prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a low-speed head-on collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1090; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, so I'll just say I was the passenger in the vehicle.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were sitting and what happened?

A: I was in the front passenger seat. We were stopped at a light in Pasadena, Texas, and then the other car came into our lane and hit us head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jerk me forward.

Q: How fast do you think the vehicles were going at impact?

A: Not fast at all. Maybe a few miles an hour. Both cars were barely moving when they met.

Q: Did you hit anything inside the car?

A: My right knee hit the dashboard below the glove box. I felt a sharp pain right away, and it swelled up pretty quickly.

Q: Did you seek medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to see a specialist about the knee.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that knee?

A: No, nothing serious. I played sports in school, but I haven't had any treatment for it in years.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. I have trouble bending it fully, and stairs are hard. I'm using a brace for now and I've been limping when I walk for long stretches.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm following my doctor's instructions and I want to get back to work as soon as I can.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
